method: Direct inspection of original full-window screenshots, plus X11 active-window and child-lifecycle assertions in the journey.
native_selection: Existing Dockspace panel was active after selecting Inspector from host inventory; FOCUS_RECOVERY text is visible in Inspector.
deferred_close: Inspector shows Decision postponed with Close and Keep open; Preview remains actionable.
partial_group_close: Preview is Ready to close while the full native group remains open.
cancel_group_close: Keeping Inspector open removes the confirmation and reports the complete request cancelled; the exact native child still exists.
approved_group_close: Both members approved; X11 search confirms no visible Dockspace panel remains.
reopen: Inspector is reopened in the host with the exact FOCUS_RECOVERY text retained.
keyboard_navigation: Home/End/Home/Right/Left/End show the expected target content while preserving the tab focus ring; Enter then focuses editable content and accepts KEYBOARD_ACTIVATION.
limits: Software-GL X11 only; screenshots are visual evidence, not automated widget assertions or a performance measurement.
